chunks: It is narrated from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Hoarding applies only to wheat, barley, dates, raisins, ghee, and oil.

key_terms.الْحُكْرَةُ: hoarding of goods in a manner relevant to legal prohibition

ai.seo_question: To which goods does hoarding apply in Shia fiqh according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the specific goods to which hoarding applies in this legal context. It identifies staple food items and essential consumables as the subject of ihtikar, indicating a focused fiqh ruling related to market conduct and public need.
